attacks.name: Mental Bolts
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Engines of Destruction
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.

|!wild| |*Scientific Malpractice|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§shock§Shock|, |§slow§Slow|, or |§stun§Stun|.

superPowers.name: I Have Calculated All Possible Outcomes to Your Defeat (Affiliation: Intelligencia)
superPowers.body: When an allied character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least 1 |!critical|. A character can gain only 1 |!power| as a result of this |!leadership| ability per Turn.

superPowers.name: You Are Here to Obey
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 4. The chosen character Advances |!range_small|. A character can be Advanced by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Psychokinesis
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Mental Monolith
superPowers.body: This character cannot be Pushed or Advanced by the special rules of |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers. Additionally, when this character would suffer |!damage| from a collision, reduce the amount suffered by 1.
